purpose: Teach: 実地/旅費/引数/業態/格付け/送迎/旅客/打ち込ん

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、実地で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、苦労したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In the founding days, your father worked with real conviction—absolutely real hardship, you understand. I'm counting on you to remember that.
lines.style: Slow, measured cadence. Weight on each principle word. The voice of memory settling into responsibility. Sparing but deliberate. Closing with quiet insistence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、旅費、絶対、節約、絶対、続けてまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, I'll continue that dedication—absolutely—managing every resource with care. My gratitude for his example is real.
lines.style: Formal but not cold. Steady eye-contact rhythm. Each commitment lands cleanly. Respectful pause before the gratitude acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの時代、本気で、絶対、引数、絶対、いう言葉、絶対、まだ、なかったぞ、ばあさんから、聞いた、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In your father's day, those business terms didn't even exist yet—your grandmother told me that. I want you to understand that.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly distant. Breath-pause between the thought and the want. Not wistful, but grounded in a fact that matters. Trailing gently on the final thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、業態、絶対、進化、絶対、続いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's generation, I've watched how the business has evolved. I continue that evolution with gratitude for what came before.
lines.style: Thoughtful tempo. Recognition of continuity without dwelling. Firm but connected to the past. The voice of someone aware he holds something larger than himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 当社の格付け、本気で、絶対、お父さんの代から、絶対、業界、絶対、上位、絶対、保ってきた、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Our company's standing—we've kept it strong at the industry's top since your father's time. That's what I'm committed to.
lines.style: Direct statement of fact. Slight emphasis on the height maintained. Tone is grounded and proud without arrogance. Clear delivery with quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの送迎、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、誇りに、絶対、思っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The spirit my father left behind—I carry it into every task. That's not just gratitude, it's my foundation.
lines.style: Tender opening on the thought of his father. Builds to resolve. The voice of a younger man finding his own conviction in inheritance. Not performing—living it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、本気で、絶対、旅客船、絶対、よく、使ったぞ、お父さん、お前にも、伝えたい、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: From the beginning, we relied on passenger ships constantly—that's something your father made sure I understood. I want to pass that same knowledge to you.
lines.style: Nostalgic but concrete. The memory has texture and specificity. Gentle pace until the final clause, where resolve firms slightly. Legacy-passing is the weight here.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの精神、本気で、絶対、業務に、絶対、打ち込んでまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. My father's spirit, his commitment to the work itself—I'll carry that forward with absolute dedication. My thanks are not just words.
lines.style: Quiet opening. Builds commitment steadily. The closing note is firm and honest—gratitude grounded in action, not sentiment. Respectful but self-possessed.
